meta.name: algorithmic-art
meta.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

copy.tagline: 用代码生成视觉艺术作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用代码创作独特的视觉艺术
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create unique visual art with code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先写一份算法艺术哲学 .md 文档，再用 p5.js 做出单文件 HTML 互动作品，带参数控件与种子；同一种子输出相同画面。
howto.when: 当你要求用代码创作生成艺术、算法艺术、流场等作品时触发；原文要求做原创作品，不照搬现有艺术家的风格。

say.text: 用流场和粒子做一幅生成艺术作品，输出成可交互的 HTML
say.note: 先写哲学文档，再产出可调参数的页面

say.text: 换个种子，再生成一版同一算法的作品
say.note: 同一种子会得到完全相同的画面

say.text: 给这个作品加几个可调参数，比如粒子数和噪声尺度
say.note: 侧边栏会出现对应参数控件

howto.what_en: After install, Claude first writes an algorithmic-art philosophy .md, then builds one self-contained p5.js HTML artwork with parameter controls and a seed; the same seed always reproduces the same image.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for code-generated art — generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields and similar. The skill says to create original work, not copy existing artists' styles.

say_en.text: Make a generative art piece with flow fields and particles in interactive HTML
say_en.note: Writes a philosophy .md first, then a parameter page

say_en.text: Change the seed and generate another version of the same algorithm
say_en.note: Same seed always gives the exact same image

say_en.text: Add a few tunable parameters, like particle count and noise scale
say_en.note: Slider controls appear in the sidebar
